# firmware-server - ESP32 固件管理服务

## 网站信息
- 名称: ESP32 Web Flasher
- 用途: ESP32 固件在线管理和烧录
- 地址: https://firmware.example.com

## API 入口
- 注册表: GET /api/registry
- 版本列表(SSE 实时推送): GET /api/registry/stream
- 固件段下载: GET /api/registry/projects/{projectId}/variants/{variant}/releases/{releaseId}/parts/{file}
- 发布固件: POST /api/publish (multipart/form-data，需 Bearer Token；字段 meta=JSON 元数据，file=固件段)
- 晋升发布版: POST /api/registry/projects/{projectId}/variants/{variant}/releases/{releaseId}/promote (需 Token，body: {"note":"说明"})
- 回滚(切换 latest): POST /api/registry/projects/{projectId}/variants/{variant}/latest (需 Token，body: {"releaseId":"..."})
- 订阅状态: POST /api/registry/projects/{projectId}/subscribe (body: {"subscribed": true|false})
- 保留策略: POST /api/registry/projects/{projectId}/retention (需 Token，body: {"snapshots": 数字或 "all"})
- 保留预览: GET /api/registry/projects/{projectId}/retention/preview?snapshots=N

## 数据结构
- 注册表: { _meta, projects: { [id]: Project } }
- Project: { id, name, description, subscribed, retention, variants: { [variant]: Variant } }
- Variant: { latest: ReleaseId, releases: [Release] }
- Release: { id, type: "snapshot"|"release", chipFamily, flashParams: { mode, freq, size }, note, createdAt, parts: [Part] }
- Part: { label, address, file, sha256, size, type?: "app"|"data", subType?: string }
- type/subType 由发布端解析 partition-table.bin 按地址匹配得出（如 app/factory、data/littlefs）

## 认证
- 发布/晋升/回滚/保留策略等写接口需要 Authorization: Bearer {token}
- token 配置在服务端环境变量 FIRMWARE_PUBLISH_TOKEN
- 读接口(registry/SSE/下载/预览) 公开无需鉴权

## 详细文档（均可直接 GET 读取，Markdown 纯文本）
- 发布指南(操作手册): /docs/PUBLISH.md
- 部署运维(runbook): /docs/DEPLOY.md
- 设计与数据模型: /docs/FIRMWARE-REGISTRY.md
- 验收清单(F-01..F-24): /docs/REQUIREMENTS.md

## 示例
- curl http://firmware.example.com/llms.txt               # 本说明文件
- curl http://firmware.example.com/api/registry            # 查看全部固件
- curl http://firmware.example.com/docs/PUBLISH.md         # 发布操作手册
- curl https://firmware.example.com/api/registry           # HTTPS 也可(自签证书)
